blocks.text: PENSACOLA, United States — Four people died in the southeastern United States as post-tropical cyclone Isaias threatened flooding and tornado risks Saturday as it moved northward after making landfall on Florida’s Gulf Coast. Isaias roared ashore late Friday as a Category 2 hurricane near the resort community of Destin, packing sustained winds of 105 miles (165 kilometers) per hour before weakening overnight, the National Hurricane Center (NHC) said. It was the first hurricane of an Atlantic season tamed by a historic El Niño weather phenomenon, and the first hurricane since 2024 to hit the US mainland. In Mary Esther, a coastal […]...
